summary: The dossiers are largely consistent with the verified current facts (record, Finals loss, extensions, City Edition, key dates), so few outright errors surfaced. Fixed: the Alamodome 'first home' error, Farfisa and Sunglows musical details, the Southwest School of Art now being part of UTSA, the Tobin Center symphony line, a Texas rodeo naming slip, an MLK Day entry implying a Spurs game, inflated 'largest Mexican market' superlatives, and two off-palette red hex values. Three live checks confirmed the San Marcos Nike Factory Store and Hogwild Records and corrected the art school. The strategy brief needs editor attention on the claim that no hand-made West Side vocabulary has reached a Spurs uniform, the Feb 15 Spurs-Heat 'road game' premise, and unverified player footwear deals. Most local businesses and artists are long-established but unchecked today.
